reason_consistency.summary: 503 citations from 300 ledger entries (20 skipped as code-generated gate reasons): 86.5% consistent, 9.4% contradicted, 4.0% weak, 132 unscored (considered verdict). 2.1% of checkable reasons cited nothing in the phrase map (vague).
